name: New Hadrian High
wants: static or space core, L or XL, pads and a market unit
note: The port over the capital, 150 km above the atmosphere. Pads for every core size, the best fuel and cells, the element shelf, the contract board, the Compact's taxes, the Wardens' headquarters. Where you leave your ship when you log off.

name: Curia Yards
wants: static or space core, L or XL, pads and a market unit
note: Fleet yards built for a fleet that never came. Empty slips you can rent as hangars; later used hulls and insurance.

name: Wallgate
wants: static or space core, L or XL, pads and a market unit
note: The last pad inside the wall and the Wardens' garrison: fuel, repairs, customs, and the patrol cutters that answer distress calls in the Belt. The Belt's contracts are posted here too.

name: Otis Exchange
wants: static or space core, L or XL, pads and a market unit
note: Where the ore comes up. Buys ore, sells fuel and parts, big pads for haulers.

name: Soren Skyhook
wants: static or space core, L or XL, pads and a market unit
note: The refinery's dock, high above a hostile surface. Ore in; pures, coolant and lubricant out. Where industry ships live.

name: Elsk Anchorage
wants: static or space core, L or XL, pads and a market unit
note: The food dock. Rations, water ice and textiles out; fertilizer and fuel in. Every food run to the Reach starts here.

name: Gravel Camp
wants: static or space core, L or XL, pads and a market unit
note: A rough outpost inside the asteroid field. Buys rock on the spot at a discount, sells fuel at a markup. Raiders like it.

name: Twinlight
wants: static or space core, L or XL, pads and a market unit
note: The frontier's only real hub, hanging in the 200 km gap between the twins. Buys T3 and T4, sells rods and catalyst, the Reach's contract board.

name: Signal
wants: static or space core, L or XL, pads and a market unit
note: A half-dead relay 12 Mm past Reach that still holds the Dominion's last transmissions. Salvage, a market that only buys, and the season-two hook.

name: New Hadrian Central
wants: static core, L or XL, pads, a market look, hangar doors
note: New Hadrian: The capital the Dominion built for itself. The Compact keeps it as if the fleet were due tomorrow.

name: Concord Landing
wants: static core, L or XL, pads, a market look, hangar doors
note: Concord: The first thing a new arrival sees: the Dominion's promise, written on a grassland moon. Then they leave it.

name: Curia Port
wants: static core, L or XL, pads, a market look, hangar doors
note: Curia: The council seat, built and never sat in. Empty chambers the Compact still guards out of habit.

name: Otis Diggings
wants: static core, L or XL, pads, a market look, hangar doors
note: Otis: The mining world, named for the man who ran the first company. Hot canyons, rich ore.

name: Soren Refinery
wants: static core, L or XL, pads, a market look, hangar doors
note: Soren: Volcanic, ash skies, free heat. Where ore becomes pures. A cold name for a hot world, on purpose.

name: Elsk Farms
wants: static core, L or XL, pads, a market look, hangar doors
note: Elsk: Ice over blue seas; the farms are under the crust where it is warm. The food lane to everywhere.

name: Nocturne Outpost
wants: static core, L or XL, pads, a market look, hangar doors
note: Nocturne: The mining twin. Thin air, permanent dusk, T3 and T4.

name: Vesper Works
wants: static core, L or XL, pads, a market look, hangar doors
note: Vesper: The refining twin, 300 km from its sister. Reactor rods and catalyst come from here.

name: Delphine Terraces
wants: static core, L or XL, pads, a market look, hangar doors
note: Delphine: A soft name for a jungle that tries to kill you. Spices and water, long haul, high margin.

name: Reach Deep Camp
wants: static core, L or XL, pads, a market look, hangar doors
note: Reach: The end of the map, on the far side of the star. The only T5. Where the last survey ship was headed when the signals stopped.
